title: save_portfolio input
description: Creates or changes a portfolio (O01). Served only to a person in the product's web app: a portfolio's place in the tree scopes approval rules, decision rights and portfolio access. The platform admin creates, moves, names the accountable person and retires; the PMO edits the name, description and level. A portfolio never sits inside itself or its own children, and two siblings never share a name.

portfolioId.description: The portfolio to change. Leave it out to create one.

levelKey.description: The level, from the portfolio-level list.

clearParent.description: True moves it to the top of the tree.

accountablePrincipalObjectId.description: The person who answers for the portfolio, found with find_people.

isActive.description: False retires the portfolio. Its applications keep their history.
